discovery.summary: Read the current particle buffer of a live stateful CPU Niagara emitter on an actor in PIE (preferred) or the editor world. Reports the real total and a bounded snapshot. Position is converted from Niagara LWC/local simulation coordinates to world space in Unreal units; all other vectors retain simulation space. No assets are saved. Only explicitly passing advanceTicks > 0 advances this component with AdvanceSimulation before the read; this can run completion callbacks. Missing attributes list available compiled attributes; GPU/stateless emitters return NOT_SUPPORTED. An explicit positive advance can initialize a pending first spawn before validating the new particle buffer; existing emitter/type/attribute data is validated first when available.
whenToUse: Numerically inspect CPU particle Position, Velocity or other compiled attributes on a live Niagara component.
Compare a Scratch module result after explicitly advancing a running simulation.
whenNotToUse: GPU or stateless emitters: no GPU readback is implemented.

Inactive or completed systems: this call does not activate or reset them. Without advanceTicks > 0, pending-first-tick/missing-buffer systems return NO_SIMULATION_DATA with guidance; completed instances return SYSTEM_COMPLETE.
Actors with multiple Niagara components: the target would be ambiguous.
A strictly observational request must omit advanceTicks and tickDeltaSeconds.

actorName.description: Exact actor label, unique object name or full object path in PIE if running, otherwise editor world. Must identify one actor with exactly one Niagara component.

emitterName.description: Exact emitter handle display name (case-insensitive); errors list available instance names.

attributes.description: Compiled attribute names, e.g. Position, Velocity or Particles.Position. Duplicate requests are coalesced. Unused attributes may be optimized out.

maxParticles.description: Maximum particles returned per attribute; particleCount is the uncapped current buffer count.

advanceTicks.description: Explicit opt-in to advance this component synchronously before reading. Does not unpause, activate or reset. Can complete the system; failure after advancing does not undo simulation. Omitted or zero means no advance. A pending first spawn or missing current buffer does not block an explicit positive advance.

tickDeltaSeconds.description: Simulation step, only with advanceTicks; must exceed engine SMALL_NUMBER. Omitted defaults to 1/60.

particleCount.description: Real total number in the current CPU buffer, before limiting.

age.description: System age after the snapshot wait/optional advance.

type.description: Engine type display name. Float/Int are numbers, Bool is boolean; Vector2 is [x,y], Vector/Position [x,y,z], Vector4/Quat [x,y,z,w], Color [r,g,b,a].

coordinateSpace.description: Present for Position only; other vectors retain simulation space.

attributes.description: Same buffer indices across attributes, not stable particle IDs across calls. Non-finite or invalid reader values fail the request; no zero-filled fallback.

examples.title: Read up to 100 CPU particle positions and velocities without advancing.
